title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion in User Service
summary: Database connection pool saturated causing HTTP 500 errors across auth and user management endpoints after deployment v2.4.1.
symptoms: Database connection pool active connections at 100/100 limit
root_cause: Unclosed database connections in user activity tracking middleware introduced in v2.4.1 deployment.
resolution: Applied hotfix patch v2.4.2 to properly release DB connections in try-finally block and scaled max_connections temporarily to 200.
